note: First real block of the colony. The Worker on Issue #25 (whole interface in pt-BR) hit max_turns at 61 turns without ever committing; nothing was pushed and the Issue stayed in-progress with no PR, which would have been retried blindly every 4 hours. Infrastructure change (specimen commit 4ad66af): a failed Worker execution with no PR now labels the Issue blocked with the reason and turns, no automatic retry; the blocked label wakes the Queen at once; Workers are told to push work in slices and to prefer bulk edits; Worker max_turns 60 to 100; concurrency groups moved to job level so discarded label events cannot cancel a pending real run. The human then labelled #25 blocked by hand with the facts. The Queen was woken by the label within seconds, closed #25, admitted her one-PR decision was wrong, and split it into #26, #27 and #28.
